generateImage.label: Generate an AI image
generateImage.description: Creates an image from a prompt. Returns a generation ID; use Get generation status to retrieve the completed image. Uses Magic Hour credits.

faceSwapPhoto.label: Swap faces in a photo
faceSwapPhoto.description: Swaps a face into a photo. Returns a generation ID; use Get generation status with Image to retrieve the completed result. Uses Magic Hour credits.

faceSwapVideo.label: Swap faces in a video
faceSwapVideo.description: Swaps a face into a video clip. Returns a generation ID; use Get generation status with Video to retrieve the completed result. Uses Magic Hour credits.

imageToVideo.label: Animate an image
imageToVideo.description: Animates an image with LTX 2.5 at 480p. Returns a generation ID; use Get generation status with Video to retrieve the completed clip. Uses Magic Hour credits.

textToVideo.label: Generate a video from text
textToVideo.description: Creates a video from a prompt with LTX 2.5 at 480p. Returns a generation ID; use Get generation status with Video to retrieve the clip. Uses Magic Hour credits.

getGenerationStatus.label: Get generation status
getGenerationStatus.description: Retrieves the status, charged credits, download links and errors for an existing image, video or audio generation. Does not create another generation.

makeApiCall.label: Make an API call
makeApiCall.description: Performs an authorized call to the Magic Hour API. Supports custom headers and JSON object, array, or mapped bodies; uses the attached API-key connection.
